thread:
maria: Quick sync — follow-ups from the PM #482 outage postmortem. Need to assign owners, create Jira tickets, and confirm RACI. Main remediation items: (1) cache eviction tuning, (2) rollout config guardrails, (3) on-call playbook updates. Can we do a quick pass today?

dan: I can own cache eviction. ETA end of next week? I'll spin up a ticket.

liam: I'll take rollout guardrails. Need someone to own verification tests — @sophia?

sophia: I can handle verification tests + playbook edits. Can we set due dates? prefer 2w for tests, 1w for playbook.

jira-bot: Created tickets: PROJ-893 (cache-eviction-tuning), PROJ-894 (rollout-guardrails), PROJ-895 (oncall-playbook-update). Links: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PROJ-893, https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PROJ-894, https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/PROJ-895

ops-bot: Added checklist to each ticket: - runbook drafted - runbook reviewed - automation PR - canary config - monitor alerting

dan: RACI suggestion: Responsible=owner, Accountable=Eng Leads, Consulted=SRE, Informed=Support+CS. For PROJ-893 R=dan, A=me? maybe A should be @maria since she led the postmortem.

liam: I can be A for PROJ-894. For PROJ-893 I think @maria should be A since she led the postmortem.

maria: Works for me. Confirming: PROJ-893 R=dan A=maria C=SRE I=CS/Support; PROJ-894 R=liam A=liam C=platform I=customers; PROJ-895 R=sophia A=product C=oncall I=all.

sophia: Handoff steps for playbook: 1) draft doc in Confluence, 2) include runbook snippet, 3) add step-by-step run through with oncall, 4) schedule 30m dry-run. I'll do 1-3 by EOD Thursday. pinging @oncall for availability.

liam: Quick note on recurring pattern: cache evictions spike at ~03:00 UTC after deploys. We should add a metric and pager threshold. I'll add to PROJ-893.

maria: Timeline: can we target next Friday for ownership confirm and initial PRs? If any blockers flag in PROJ comments. Also let's do a weekly 15m follow-up each Tuesday. I'll create calendar invite.

dan: Ack :thumbsup: Adding a 'severity regression' test to rollout job too.

sophia: I'll file a small doc snippet for handoff procedures and tag the RACI. Also will add 'acceptance criteria' to each ticket with an explicit verification checklist.

maria: Thanks — I'll update the postmortem doc with the tickets and RACI table. Closing the thread once PRs are opened. :rocket:
